question: Which of the following is NOT a work of Kalidasa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kama Sutra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vatsyayana:**

 
 
• ​Vatsyayana is the author of **Nyaya Sutra Bhashya and Kamasutra**.
 
• **Nyaya Sutra Bhashya** is considered the first commentary on Gautama Nyaya Sutras.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efb90c3647c276e117dc17fb6439410dad00fafe8f511a89c38f32cba7de65df.png] 

 
• **Kalidasa:**

 
 
• ​He is a classical Sanskrit writer and is widely regarded as the greatest poet and playwright of the Gupta era.
 
• **The six major works of Kalidasa are:**
 
 
• Shakuntala
 
• Vikramorvashi
 
• Malavikagnimitram
 
• The epic poems Raghuvamsa
 
• Kumarasambhava
 
• Meghaduta
